checks: Owner queue rejects guests and other identities.
Private drafts stay out of the queue; submitted quote requests persist with server-calculated totals and idempotent retries.
Customer sessions are isolated; submitted requests cannot be deleted through the private-draft endpoint.
Owner status updates appear to the customer; stale updates are rejected.
Duplicate product lines, nonexistent products, and newly sold-out products cannot create a request; a received request remains retryable.
Trade-in and service submissions use the same durable queue; impossible appointment dates are rejected.
scope: Built Worker with isolated local D1/R2; no live orders, messages or payments.
